events.title: New Demo Out Now for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Into the Haunted land is taking part in Steam Next Fest, and our new demo is now live! This update brings the following improvements for our adventurers:The demo version has been updated to 1.2.You can check the version number in the bottom-right corner of the start screen. If it has not updated, please restart Steam!Into The Haunted Land Demo Version 1.2Major ChangesAdded the vehicle upgrade system, including a dedicated upgrade shop.Added an in-game encyclopedia.Rebalanced game difficulty.Adde

events.title: Into The Haunted Land Demo Version 1.0
events.summary: Major UpdatesAdded Arachnophobia ModeAdded Blood MoonAdjusted the demo to end on Day 9, after the second quotaMinor UpdatesAdded a hint when finish demo without collecting an Omen itemMonsters will no longer appear right after entering a ruinAdded the option to give up the Last Chance manuallyFixed a CTD issue reported on some PCsAdjusted the light flickering issueImproved connection stability
